motivation: Three of four preserved current-support stops have at least200 geometrically qualified center sources per current factor but lose them in legacy bilinear-normal neighborhood probes; test admission using the fitted depth field
data_role: already viewed outcome-informed development, not held-out validation
initial_seed: Keep the original raw reciprocal matching, bilinear center sampling, target center normal eligibility, source-normal alignment>0.8, target-point distance0.08m at scale1 and minimum200 sources per factor. Seed normals, point coordinates and bilinear-center gradient-length metric normalizers remain unchanged
only_admission_change: Apply the original nine initial target-image offsets(-1,0,1)^2 at fixed target optical Z using the exact one-sided C1 depth sampler employed during fitting, instead of the old bilinear sampler that requires target normals at all probe corners. Preserve the original probe body, finite-gradient gate and minimum200 slicing rule
domain: Original prepared one-sided inverse-depth fields, four measured corners, depth continuity, positive finite inverse depth, finite derivatives and image/front bounds remain mandatory. No missing-depth filling, changed initial center geometry or lowering source-count thresholds
source_receipts: Report old/new/source-seed populations, retained old IDs, newly admitted IDs, lost old IDs and factor counts. Check exact source point/normal/normalizer values against original geometric seed and exact equality on old/new intersections. Retention is retained_old/old; expanded_population/old is a separate ratio
fixed_attempt: Select once at the original initial poses, then freeze the entire admitted source population, original normalizers, prepared fields and incoming nonlinear prior throughout the90-correction attempt. No candidate-dependent source dropout, re-selection or weight reset at30/60
unchanged_solver: Private unchanged extended refiner/objective/search/checkpoint functions bind only the new population. Same Huber0.01m loss,90 cap,21 Armijo candidates1..2^-20 with original slack, current support, scaled SPD condition<=1e6, full proposal<=0.1m/0.15rad and strict full-proposal convergence1e-5m/1e-5rad. No damping or new regularization
stage_diagnosis: For each raw pair with at least200 candidates, independently reconstruct raw counts, bilinear geometric center counts, legacy bilinear9-probe counts and new fitted-model9-probe counts, including counts below admission threshold. Older factors do not replace measured current-frame support
independent_verification: Separate original center geometry/normalizer selector and old probe oracle, homogeneous new offsets, independently prepared one-sided fields and polynomial interpolation. Private unchanged extended verifier functions bind only new population. Prior/incidence matrices, spectral solves, Rodrigues search and checkpoints are reconstructed; original extended controls stay isolated and are separately rechecked
analytic_controls: A measured depth patch survives absent unused probe normals while original center normal/source alignment gates still apply; missing probe depth rejects. Inherited interpolation/eight side-availability checks, actual rendered warm/degenerate fits,12 nonzero-prior gradient axes, four report corruptions,30/60/90 checkpoint verification and future-state checkpoint substitution rejection for any actual continuation beyond30
followup_eligibility_rule: Both cases converge all five new windows, improve original-discrete fresh convergence, have no local/fresh guards, pass original0.03m RMS gates and have median original-discrete fresh RMS no worse than extended control
scope: More residuals from existing measured frames change objective composition and raw/prior balance; absolute total costs across populations are not an accuracy comparison. No claim that added residuals are independent new measurements. No numeric real reference labels, physical trajectory score, new continuous trajectory, tracker/prior/Schur commit, native/default adoption or timing evidence
